# HighlyTheoretical: the Sega core behind both DSF (Dreamcast) and SSF (Saturn).
#
# One core, two formats and two machines. The version byte selects which --
# `0x11` Saturn, `0x12` Dreamcast -- and the API takes it as `version - 0x10`,
# so most of this library is the shared part: `yam.c` is the Yamaha AICA/SCSP
# sound chip both consoles use, `arm.c` the ARM7 that drives it on Dreamcast,
# and Musashi the 68000 that drives it on Saturn.
#
# Only the sources Cog's Xcode project compiles. The tree also ships `c68k/` and
# `Starscream/` -- two further 68000 implementations -- and neither is built:
# `USE_M68K` selects Musashi, and the other two are dead weight from upstream's
# history.
find_package(ZLIB REQUIRED)

add_library(vendor-highlytheoretical STATIC
    Core/arm.c
    Core/dcsound.c
    Core/satsound.c
    Core/sega.c
    Core/yam.c
    Core/m68k/m68kcpu.c
    # Generated by m68kmake from m68k_in.c, and checked in upstream, so there is
    # no code generator to run at build time.
    Core/m68k/m68kops.c)

target_include_directories(vendor-highlytheoretical SYSTEM PUBLIC
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
# `emuconfig.h` is included both ways -- `<HighlyTheoretical/emuconfig.h>` from
# sega.h and plain `"emuconfig.h"` from arm.h, yam.h and satsound.h -- so the
# one copy lives under HighlyTheoretical/ and that directory is on the path as
# well. Keeping two copies would work and would be two files to diverge.
target_include_directories(vendor-highlytheoretical PRIVATE
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Core"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Core/m68k"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/HighlyTheoretical")
target_link_libraries(vendor-highlytheoretical PUBLIC ZLIB::ZLIB)
set_target_properties(vendor-highlytheoretical PROPERTIES FOLDER vendor)

# Cog's defines, taken from its Xcode project rather than guessed.
#
# EMU_LITTLE_ENDIAN is a statement about the host, and it is correct for every
# platform this tree targets; a big-endian port would need it conditional.
# USE_M68K picks Musashi over the two unbuilt alternatives.
target_compile_definitions(vendor-highlytheoretical PRIVATE
    EMU_COMPILE EMU_LITTLE_ENDIAN HAVE_STDINT_H LSB_FIRST USE_M68K)

if(WIN32)
    # yam.c takes its own <windows.h> path for executable memory; HAVE_MPROTECT
    # is the POSIX alternative and must not be set here.
    target_compile_definitions(vendor-highlytheoretical PRIVATE
        NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN)
else()
    target_compile_definitions(vendor-highlytheoretical PRIVATE HAVE_MPROTECT)
endif()

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_definitions(vendor-highlytheoretical PRIVATE
        _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS _CRT_NONSTDC_NO_WARNINGS)
    target_compile_options(vendor-highlytheoretical PRIVATE /w)
else()
    target_compile_options(vendor-highlytheoretical PRIVATE -w)
endif()
